question: A university has 500 faculty members (male and female only) out of which females are 60%. The average height of females is 162 cm and that of males is 168 cm. What is the average faculty height (in cm ) of the university?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of females to males = 60% : 40% = 3 : 2

Let the assumed average be 162 cm (female average).

Deviation of male average from assumed average = 168 − 162 = +6 cm

Total positive deviation for males = 2 ratio parts × 6 = +12

Net average increase = +12 ÷ (3 + 2) total parts = +2.4 cm

Overall average = 162 + 2.4 = 164.4 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 164.4 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total faculty members = 500

Percentage of females = 60%

Average height of females = 162 cm

Average height of males = 168 cm

**Formula Used:**

Overall Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)
